paragraphs: Hamnuna: Rabbi Abba was his son. [Glosses: Hamnuna. A) Berakhot 24a: Rav Hamnuna son of Rav Yosef; so too Rif, but Asheri reads Rabbi Nechemyah bar Rav Yosef; L.T. [ל״ת]. B) Gittin 39,end of side b: Rabbi Shmuel bar Achotai said: Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan said: Rav Huna said in Rav Hamnuna’s name. It seems to me the second Hamnuna is a scribal error, since Sukkah 42a has Rav Huna said in Rav’s name.]
